title: AI Jobs Intelligence Platform
description: Track every AI and ML job opening across 200+ companies. Get structured data with skills, frameworks, experience levels, and optional AI enrichment.

sources.title: Job sources
sources.description: Which job boards to scrape. All seven are enabled by default.

keywords.title: Keyword filter
keywords.description: Only include jobs containing at least one of these keywords. Leave empty to include all AI-relevant jobs.

companies.title: Company filter
companies.description: Only include jobs from these companies (partial match). Leave empty to include all companies.

experienceLevels.title: Experience level filter
experienceLevels.description: Only include jobs matching these experience levels. Leave empty to include all levels.

parseAllResults.title: Parse all results
parseAllResults.description: Ignore the max output limit and scrape all available jobs from the selected sources.

maxItems.title: Max output items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of job records to output per run. Ignored if 'Parse all results' is enabled.

classifyWithAI.title: Enable AI enrichment
classifyWithAI.description: Use an LLM to enrich jobs with structured metadata (skills, frameworks, experience level). Requires GROQ_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

classificationMode.title: Classification mode
classificationMode.description: How to classify jobs. Deterministic is free and fast. Hybrid uses LLM only for uncertain jobs. AI classifies every job with LLM.
enumTitles: AI (LLM for every job, most thorough)

llmProvider.title: LLM provider
llmProvider.description: Which LLM to use for AI enrichment. Set the corresponding API key in environment variables.

tier.title: Access tier
tier.description: Controls output limits and features. Free tier includes 100 jobs from 2 sources.

detectChanges.title: Detect changes (incremental mode)
detectChanges.description: Compare this run against the previous run to detect new, updated, and removed jobs.

proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
proxy.description: Route requests through Apify Proxy to avoid rate limits. Recommended for large runs.

customGreenhouseTokens.title: Custom Greenhouse tokens
customGreenhouseTokens.description: Add custom Greenhouse company board tokens. Find tokens at boards.greenhouse.io/{token}.

customLeverSlugs.title: Custom Lever slugs
customLeverSlugs.description: Add custom Lever company slugs. Find slugs at lever.co/{slug}.

alertKeywords.title: Alert keywords
alertKeywords.description: Send webhook when a new job matches these keywords. Requires webhook URL.

alertMinSalary.title: Alert minimum salary
alertMinSalary.description: Send webhook when a new job has salary above this threshold. Set to 0 to disable.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Slack, Discord, or custom webhook URL for job alerts. Leave empty to disable.
